notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes: We slightly changed the "Credits" by adding a link to our new game "Tawako The Forest Hedgehog" which will be released in the middle of July.

notes.title: Change of the game release date
notes.notes:
Hello friends!
We are sorry for this late message but the release date of the game was postponed due to additional checks and fixes.
We will release the game on May 10th, however, depending on your time zone it might be May 11th.
We hope you will enjoy the game and provide us with useful feedback!
